title: Hauptstraße, Eschborn
description:
* Ladies’ shared flat (please no applications from men. Thank you) :)
* Large two-floor apartment (245 sqm)
* Beautiful, spacious flat in a historic estate (former winery) in the heart of Eschborn – central yet very quiet
* Excellent public transport connections and great local infrastructure
* Fully equipped spacious kitchen (including dishwasher and two refrigerators) combined with dining and living area
* Three bathrooms in total
* Sunny, spacious balcony with seating area
* Stable, high-quality Wi-Fi
* All rooms are fully furnished
* This ad is for Room #2, the smallest of the rooms available for rent
* The shared flat has a storage room, pantry, and laundry room  with washing machine and dryer (paid by use, costs not included in the flat rate utilities) 
* Each rented room includes a proportional share of common areas amounting to approx. 60% of the total individually rented space, adding up to 245 sqm of total living and usable space
* In the adjoining barn, there is a covered bicycle parking area where bikes can be stored dry and safely
* Parking spaces in the courtyard can be rented for €35/month if desired (optional)
*  Your lovely landlord lives in the neighbouring house and is happy to help with any issues
*  The property is a former farmhouse in a second-row location. The complex is charming and well maintained and secure

The cleaning fee upon moving out can be avoided if the tenant returns his room and the communal area in a fully cleaned state also returning his bed stuff cleaned.

title: Hauptstraße, Eschborn
